data.summary:
As an engineering graduate with hands-on experience in Cisco Routers, Switches, SD-WAN, Wireless technologies, and real-time network troubleshooting, I have developed a strong foundation in the networking field. I am looking forward to working with companies where I can learn, work and grow professionally and personally.
Network Engineer with 4.8+ years of hands-on experience in managing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure.
Cisco CCNA certified and Cisco SD-WAN certified, currently pursuing CCNP Routing & Switching and Cisco SD-WAN training to further enhance technical expertise.
Proficient in supporting and resolving issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks, ensuring
optimal performance and reliability. Skilled at engaging with stakeholders to deliver clear and accurate updates on projects, incidents, and service improvements.
Possess strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with customers, internal teams, and cross-functional units.
Demonstrated ability to resolve high-impact technical issues under pressure, maintaining service continuity and minimizing downtime.
Highly attentive to detail, capable of managing multiple technical priorities simultaneously in fast- paced environments.
Committed to customer satisfaction, with a strong service-oriented mindset and a focus on delivering quality support and solutions.
Working as Lead Engineer for (Latin America) region, handling critical network incidents
and service requests. Leading bridge calls with customers, ISP teams, and internal engineering teams for faster issue resolution.
Troubleshooting SD-WAN, routing, switching, MPLS, VPN related issues in real-time. - Performing L1/L2 network troubleshooting for enterprise WAN environment. - Coordinating with ISP providers for circuit outages, packet loss, latency and routing issues
SD-WAN SKILLS
Cisco SD-WAN Architecture (Controller-based design) - - WAN Edge router configuration (cEdge / vEdge) - - Application-Aware Routing (AAR) - TLOC & OMP routing concepts - SD-WAN overlay & underlay design
vManage, vSmart, vBond configuration & troubleshooting
SD-WAN policy creation (Centralized & Local policies)
VPN segmentation (VPN 0, 10, 512 etc.) - - - Troubleshooting SD-WAN fabric issues SD-WAN template configuration Software upgrade via vManage
